description: This file defines the TransmissionManager interface, which declares methods for managing transmission operations such as starting, sending queries, ending queries, and stopping within the ECU communication module.

classes.name: TransmissionManager
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for managing ECU communication transmission processes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes or starts the transmission process.

methods.name: sendQueries
methods.description: Sends a collection of EcuQuery objects using a specified polling mode.

methods.name: endQueries
methods.description: Signals the end of query transmission.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops or terminates the transmission process.
